## What changes and why?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant; small fixes do not need one.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Mention any platform-specific checks you could not run. Include a sanitized screenshot for visual changes where useful.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read the contribution guide and kept the change focused.
- [ ] I included relevant checks or explained why they do not apply.
- [ ] The diff and attachments contain no credentials, private transcripts or local state.
